[*] Added Map Dead Names

[/list]


[i]Obviously, things need to be play tested still to make sure all is working as it should. If anything needs to be Patched, I will push another update to patch any issues, but the next full update won't be until April, and we should be testing dedicated servers in April![/i]

notes.title: Wednesday Community Test Night
notes.content:
[b]Good Afternoon Transthusiast and Happy Holidays![/b] As I'm sure the same is true for everyone, these past couple of months have been pretty hectic for me. Not just with the Holidays but normal everyday head aches around my home have been keeping me from being able to work on Trans Ops. Due to this reason I will be skipping this month major update along with testing.

That being said, this doesn't mean people can't play when they want or that I wont be pushing some kind of small update between now and the next [b]Wednesday Community Test Night, which wont be until at least 1/22/2025.[/b] This could change. 

I have a ton of work to do obvious if you have played the game. I have a ton I wanted to get done in the past month and haven't working on any of it.

[h3]I need to rebuild the lobby.[/h3]

[i]Change the code and visuals. So people are able to switch teams on game modes that allow it. The code needs to be able to change the player list visually if the match has teams or if the match is Free for all and Last Man Standing list everyone on one list before the match. This alone will take me some time.[/i]

[h3]Getting the Game ready for Dedicated Servers.[/h3]

[i]Rebuilding the lobby is part of this, actually needed to set the dedicated servers up the way I want them to be set up. Learning how and actually building the code for dedicated servers will also take me some time.[/i]


Along with the list of work above I also need to tackle existing issues and bugs with the game. Like the gas on Last Man Standing game mode, few bugs in character select code, mini map issues, UAV issues. Just a bunch of general bugs. Lastly bugs and scale fixes on Binary Market Court. 

A ton to do and not enough time for one person. I will do my best to get this done from now until 1/22/25 but December is a pretty bust month. So we will see. Thank you to all that support the game and play every test night. Sorry I'm not faster at this. Still a long learning process for me.

notes.title: Wednesday Community Test Night
notes.content:
[h3]Good afternoon fellow Transthusiast! It's been a short 3 weeks. Election Day in America! Get your Vote out![/h3]

Due to events in my personal life these past 3 weeks have been quite hectic and haven't left much time for me to work on the game. In short, the next [b]Wednesday Community Test Night won't be held until 11/20/2024.[/b] To all Trans Ops Contributors, we are currently running a Poll in #transpolling to possibly move Wednesday Community Test Night to Friday or Saturday.  Get your Vote in!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iWVv9wy.jpeg[/img]


[b]Some good news, we should have a new Map to test on 11/20/2024[/b] [h2]Binary Market Court[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hIvvJg1.jpeg[/img]
To view more build images of [b]Binary Market Court[/b] join the [b]Trans Ops Discord[/b] https://discord.gg/S5BzzeryKT and check [i]#binary-market-court[/i] channel. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FXcQE4x.png[/img]

[b]I have a ton of work I want to get done in these next two and a half weeks. Of course, getting Binary Market Court Game Mode ready. I also want to test this map with a new Game Mode in which it was created for, Demolition. We currently have Search and Destroy which is like demolition but only the SWAT Team can plant the bomb. Demolition allows both teams to be able to plant/disarm the bomb on the opposing teams' plant. Still need to work on Last Man Standing as well, so I won't be getting stuck on making a new game mode for 3 weeks. Much to be done.
[/b]


I also have a bunch of bugs to fix from the last play test, and I want to rebuild the Lobby getting it ready for Dedicated Servers. This entails, 

[list]
[*] Fixing player team placement on list and allowing team switching before matches depending on game mode. 
[*] Building 3 different versions of the Lobby. We have currently test 2 of those versions. 
[*] Voting for Game Mode, code randomly selects Map for that Game mode. 
[*] First user to join/create Match Selection (we have been testing this every week, host selection) the first player to join the dedicated server or to create a lobby would be the Match Coordinator, he/she will pick the Game Mode and Map to play.
[*] The 3rd version is a preset Map Rotation (strictly for dedicated servers) that is Dev set. A rotation of 12 Maps 2 Game Modes for each map, making a list of 24 map rotation that will continuously run. 
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FXcQE4x.png[/img]

[b]If the above goes smoothly (it won't, not enough time) I also would like to start working on adding "Vaulting" being able to climb over or up small walls along with the ladder climbing in the game would be great.[/b] So to recap, I have a ton of work I want to get done being one person, the next [b]Wednesday Community Test Night will be held on 11/20/2024 at 8pm EST[/b] until whenever people sign off.

notes.title: Trans Ops v0.435099 Live!
notes.content:
This update took 4 months to build. Again, this is all being done by one person. This game is all my experience with Unreal 5. Thank you to all contributors and testers!

[i]Below are a list of changes in Trans Ops v0.435099.[/i]


[h3]Menu Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] New Menus added.
[*] Layout, buttons and colors changed.
[*] Sounds, music/audio changed.
[/list]


[h3]Game Modes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Default Points/Kills to win on all game modes changed.
[*] Team color changed.
[*] Number of Default bots on all game modes changed.
[*] No bots in lobbies.
[*] Game mode announcer sounds added.
[*] Auto Side switching set to every 3 rounds.
[/list]



[h3]Spectating [/h3](when dead)

[list]
[*] Spectating added to all game modes. Still shows "Killer Cam" you are able to switch to another player after. Then spawn again if game mode allows respawn.
[/list]



[h3]Player Profile [/h3]

[list]
[*] This is where all player saved information will be stored and viewed.
[*] Player name, Favorite SWAT or MERC Character. 
[*] Rank and Kills/Deaths along with points will also be viewed here when ranking system is added to the game.
[/list]


[h3]Leaderboard[/h3]

[list]
[*] This is only here to show where it will be in the future (place marker). Ranking system currently not working.
[/list]



[h3]Character Selection[/h3]

[list]
[*] 16 Character are now in the game. 8 SWAT Characters and 8 MERC Characters
[*] Players are able to choose from these characters before matches in the Character Selection Menu.
[*] Players may also use a Random Character Option which will spawn a different character for that team each after each death.
[/list]



[h3]Lobby Menu[/h3]

[list]
[*] Here you are now able to create a Multiplayer Lobby. You can choose to name the lobby or username will be default lobby name.
[*] Lobby Sessions defer from A Casual Session. Casual Session are Multiplayer and allow bots, players join after the match is already created. Unranked.
[*] Lobby Sessions do not allow bots players can join before the match is started (also while in progress and spectate) vote for the game mode they would like to play. The Server auto picks the map, then travel to the match with the host of the lobby. Ranked.
[*] ***Ranking System Currently Not Working***
[*] After the Match is complete players then travel back to the Lobby with the Host to Vote on next Game Mode to play.
[/list]



[h3]Maps Added[/h3]

[u][b]Camp Confusion[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] This map has a day and night version. 2 Game Modes are linked to this Map. 2 Only in lobby match, 1 mode for Casual and Singleplayer
[/list]



[u][b]Trans Arena [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] This map has 2 Game Modes linked to it. 2 Only in lobby match, 1 mode for Casual and Singleplayer.
[/list]




[h3]Weapons[/h3]

[list]
[*] All weapons revamped, either tightened or loosened on aim/spread/recoil and damage.
[/list]


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


You will find that the Lobby side of the game runs best. Once again as I have said on every update. If you aren't running at least 6 Core CPU and 2070 GPU or equivalent your PC will struggle to run these maps. This game was created for NVIDIA 30 Series GPU's or equivalent and at the least 6 Core CPU's. Most of these maps are running Lumen Lighting, Lumen Reflections, Full Ray Traced Shadows, and Nanite. All supported by NVIDIA 30 Series and above GPU's. If textures look weird lightening seemed messed up, you could be running AMD GPU on a Lumen map with ray tracing. Not supported by AMD. Mess with your video settings, turning shadows down may help. 



[u][b]This game is being built and tested with:[/b][/u]

[i]OS - Windows 10
Engine - Unreal 5.1
MB - MSI X570
CPU - AMD 5900x
GPU - RTX 3080
Memory - 32gb 3600mhz
Hard Drive - 1tb Samsung 980 pro
Monitor - Ausus 27" 165hz .4ms
Resolution - 1440p
Graphic Settings - High 
FPS in Game - Average 85 - 120[/i]

[/list]


[i]The Maps and Modes above were the only Maps/Modes optimized in this update. These maps were optimized to work best in High Quality Graphic Settings. Game built and tested with RTX3080 GPU and AMD 5900x CPU High Quality Graphic Settings.[/i]


I haven't heard any crashing issues after the last update. Play through this one. [b]See if we can get a session going with 5 or 6 humans in the next night or two. So we can see how well the maps above run before, I copy theses "master maps" to their children "Game Modes."[/b] I have been stuck on level optimizing and haven't worked on much else. I left WACO for last because it needs a ton more work compared to the other maps. Once the other 4 are running decently well I will move on to WACO. Which means Character Selection and Lobby System have been put on hold for a bit.
